subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Negligent
solution: The correct answer is '**Careful**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Negligent**' is '**Careful**'. • **Negligent**: failing to take proper care over something. (किसी चीज की उचित देखभाल करने में असफल होना) • *Example: She was **negligent** in her work.* • **Careful**: thinking about what you are doing so that you do not have an accident or make mistakes, etc. (सावधान, ख़बरदार, सतर्क) • *Example: Be **careful**! There's a car coming.* **Correct Answer:__** *Careful.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Faithful**: always staying with and supporting a person, organization or belief. [(व्‍यक्ति, संस्‍था, मत आदि के प्रति) सच्‍चा और निष्‍ठावान] • **Indifferent**: not interested in or caring about somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में रुचि या सोच-विचार से रहित; उदासीन) • **Strange**: unusual or unexpected. (असामान्‍य या अप्रत्‍याशित; विचित्र; अजीब) 159:Ta9e, The correct answer is **'DBAC'.**
